contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA ROMANORVM ; D/ DN VALENTINI- ANVS PF AVG

Copper alloy Nummus of Valentinian I, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads: GLORIA ROMANORVM. Reverse: Emperor dragging captive to right. Mint: Siscia AD 367-375. LRBC: p73 c.f. 1408 passim. Obverse legend reads: DN VALENTINI- ANVS PF AVG. Obverse: Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed bust facing right. Die axis: 12 o'clock
